# pet-golden fixtures

Golden-pair fixtures for the BIDSvue M12 PET importer TypeScript port
([`src/lib/import/pet/`](../../../src/lib/import/pet/)). Each subdirectory
holds three files representing the inputs and expected output of a single
PET-DICOM-to-BIDS conversion case:

| File | Role |
| --- | --- |
| `dcm2niix-output.json` | Raw JSON sidecar produced by `dcm2niix -b o` against the source DICOM series. The TS port consumes this. |
| `metadata.json` | Operator-supplied PET sidecar fields (the wizard's optional metadata file). The TS port consumes this. |
| `expected-sidecar.json` | The fully-enriched BIDS-PET sidecar emitted by [`pypet2bids 1.4.6`](https://pypi.org/project/pypet2bids/1.4.6/) when run with the inputs above. The TS port must reproduce this byte-for-byte (modulo float-precision tolerance for decay-correction-derived values). |

The pairs are generated by the Phase A oracle at
[`tools/pet2bids-prototype/`](../../../tools/pet2bids-prototype/). To regenerate
or add a case:

```sh
cd tools/pet2bids-prototype
uv run pet2bids_prototype.py \
    --input  <pet2bids-images>/In/<Case> \
    --subject <Case> \
    --metadata metadata/<Case>.json \
    --output  out/<Case>
cp /tmp/pet-recon-baseline/sub-<Case>_pet.json     tests/fixtures/pet-golden/<Case>/dcm2niix-output.json
cp tools/pet2bids-prototype/metadata/<Case>.json   tests/fixtures/pet-golden/<Case>/metadata.json
cp tools/pet2bids-prototype/out/<Case>/sub-<Case>/pet/sub-<Case>_pet.json \
   tests/fixtures/pet-golden/<Case>/expected-sidecar.json
```

(The first step also re-runs `dcm2niix -b o` into `/tmp/pet-recon-baseline/`
before pypet2bids overlays its enrichment, so the captured
`dcm2niix-output.json` matches the inputs the TS port will receive at
runtime.)

The DICOM source itself is NOT committed; keep the PET2BIDS images tree outside this repository. The prototype's only contract is dcm2niix's JSON output, not the DICOM.
